data.name: Eleazariah
data.long_meaning: The name Eleazariah is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' meaning 'God' and 'Azzar' meaning 'help' or 'strength'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament, specifically in the book of Ezra, where it is the name of a high priest who led the Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem to rebuild the temple.
data.spiritual_meaning: A strong reminder of the importance of putting our trust in God and seeking His guidance and strength in all aspects of our lives.

in_hebrew.name: אלעזריה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוקים עזר לי, ה' עזר לי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלעזריה הוא שם פרטי עברי שפירושו 'אלוקים עזר לי' או 'ה' עזר לי'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אל' או 'אלוקים', שפירושו אלוהים, ו'עזר', שפירושו לעזור. השם אלעזריה מופיע בתנ'ך כבן של אחד הנסיכים של יהודה.

in_greek.name: Ελεαζαρίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελεαζαρίας είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος אלעזריה, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός μου είναι βοηθός' ή 'ο Κύριος είναι βοηθός'. Το όνομα αυτό συναντάται στην ελληνική Βίβλο, ιδιαίτερα στη μετάφραση των Septuagint.

in_latin.name: Eleazariah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eleazariah significat 'Deus meus adiutor' vel 'Dominus est adiutor meus'. Hoc nomen hebraicum est, sed in latina scriptura similiter exprimitur. Nomen Eleazariah in traditione christiana significat auxilium divinum et protectionem.

in_english.name: Eleazariah
in_english.meaning: God is my helper or Lord is my aid
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eleazariah originates from Hebrew אלעזריה, meaning 'God is my helper' or 'Lord is my aid'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'El' or 'Elohim', meaning God, and 'azar', meaning to help. Eleazariah appears in the Bible as a variant of the name Eleazar, which was borne by several individuals, including a high priest in the Old Testament. The name signifies divine assistance and guidance, reflecting a fundamental aspect of Christian faith.

biblical_reference.note: Eleazariah was a leader of the people during the time of King David.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eleazariah would have held great cultural significance to Jewish communities in biblical times due to its connection to the high priest who played an instrumental role in the rebuilding of the temple. The name may have served as a reminder of their faith and the importance of their religious traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Eleazariah is a testament to the belief in God's power and strength. It reminds us that even in difficult times, we can find help and support from God. The name is a reminder of the importance of faith, priesthood, and the temple, and serves as a reminder of the power of God to guide and protect His people.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Eleazariah appears in the records of the early Christian church. The name Eleazariah carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Eleazariah is associated with the early Christian church and its spread throughout the Mediterranean region.
